references.text: The same instruction to overlay something with pure gold is given for the ark of the covenant, showing a consistent practice for holy objects in the tabernacle.
Continues the description of the table of showbread with a gold rim around its ledge, completing the gold border mentioned in verse 24.
The altar of incense was also to be overlaid with pure gold and have a gold rim around it, following the same construction principle as the table of showbread.
Fulfillment of the instruction in 25:24, where Bezalel actually overlaid the table with pure gold and made a gold rim around it.
Solomon overlaid the interior of the temple and the altar with pure gold, showing the continuation of the tradition of using pure gold in holy spaces.
The book of Hebrews mentions the table and the showbread as part of the furnishings of the earthly sanctuary, pointing back to the tabernacle furniture described in Exodus.
